title: Chase QuickDeposit Stuck on 'Processing Please Wait': How to Unfreeze It [2026]
content:
You endorse your check, take crisp front-and-back photos, tap Submit, and the screen freezes with an infinite spinning wheel: **"Processing, please wait..."**

After waiting five or ten minutes, you are left in banking limbo: *Did the check deposit actually go through? If I force-close the app, will my money be lost? If I deposit it again, will Chase flag my account for duplicate check fraud?*

Here is the exact protocol to unfreeze the app and verify your deposit status safely.

## Why Does Chase QuickDeposit Freeze on "Processing"?

**QuickDeposit freezes when high-resolution check images exceed mobile upload socket timeouts, or when cell service drops during image transmission.** The app hangs because it is waiting for an image confirmation receipt from Chase’s optical character recognition (OCR) servers.

| Diagnostic Parameter | Information |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Feature** | Chase QuickDeposit |
| **Symptom** | Infinite spinner, frozen screen after tapping "Deposit" |
| **Primary Danger** | Accidental duplicate deposits triggering fraud flags |
| **Average Fix Time** | 3 Minutes |

> ⚠️ **CRITICAL WARNING (Do Not Re-Deposit Immediately!):** Never immediately re-take photos and submit the same check again if the screen froze. Submitting a duplicate mobile check creates a system collision that can freeze your checking account for 7 to 10 business days under suspicion of check kiting.

## The 4 Emergency Steps to Unfreeze and Verify Your Check

Follow this exact sequence to prevent account flags:

### Step 1: Force Close the Frozen Chase App
Once the spinner has run for more than 2 minutes, the TCP connection has timed out:
* **iPhone:** Swipe up from the bottom of the screen, hold, and swipe the Chase card off the top.
* **Android:** Tap the Recent Apps button and swipe Chase away, or go to **Settings** > **Apps** > **Chase** > **Force Stop**.
*Do not worry: Force-closing the app will not cancel a transaction that already reached Chase's ledger.*

### Step 2: Check "Deposit Activity" Before Taking Any Other Action
Before touching the paper check again, check your backend ledger:
1. Relaunch the Chase app and log in.
2. Tap **Pay & Transfer** > **Deposit checks**.
3. At the top right, tap **Deposit check activity** (or **History**).
4. Look for the check:
   * **If it appears as "Pending" or "Submitted":** The check went through successfully! Write *"Deposited via Mobile on [Date]"* across the top and store it in a safe place.
   * **If it does NOT appear in history:** Proceed to Step 3.

### Step 3: Check Your Checking Account Real-Time Activity
Sometimes deposits appear in the transaction ledger before appearing in deposit history:
1. Go to your **Checking Account** dashboard.
2. Review the top of your transaction list for **"Deposit - Mobile"**.
3. If 15 minutes pass and zero record exists in either Deposit Activity or Account Activity, the upload failed before reaching Chase. It is now safe to re-submit.


> 💡 **Related Chase Bank Solution:** Encountering related issues? Check our verified fix for [Chase App Not Working After Update: How to Fix App Store & Play Store Update Loops](/guides/chase-app-not-working-after-update).


### Step 4: Re-Submit with Lower Image Payload (Prevent Re-Freezing)
To ensure the second attempt does not freeze:
1. Connect to a fast, stable Wi-Fi network (avoid weak 1-bar cellular connections).
2. Place the check on a dark, flat surface under direct natural lighting.
3. Turn off any "HDR" or ultra-high-resolution camera enhancements in your phone camera settings.
4. Open Chase QuickDeposit and submit the check cleanly.

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**How long should I keep the physical paper check after a mobile deposit?**
**Chase officially recommends retaining the paper check for exactly 5 business days.** Once you confirm the funds have officially cleared into your available balance, shred or destroy the physical check.

**What happens if I write "For Chase Mobile Deposit Only" and the deposit fails?**
**If you endorsed the check with the restrictive endorsement and it failed to upload, you can still deposit it in person.** Bring the check to any Chase branch teller or Chase ATM. Both will accept checks bearing the mobile endorsement.

**What is the daily cutoff time for Chase QuickDeposit?**
**Checks submitted before 11:00 PM Eastern Time on a business day are considered received on that business day.** Submissions after 11:00 PM ET or on weekends are processed the following business morning.
